status: User-requested optional fitments; electrical integration and RF placement pending. Browser locations are display-only envelopes, not routed board placements.
purpose: Cooperative-localization ground station: UWB ranging/anchor service, with optional GNSS position and time reference.
host: Pi software through the LV/control domain; FPGA hardware timestamp capture where needed. Assign interfaces independently of existing FPGA configuration/application SPI and power telemetry.

supply.domain: DGND / local regulated 3.3 V, from protected control supply; never PGND
supply.budget_status: Provisional combined modules, regulator and antenna allowance, not a measured consumption. Recalculate THL40 thermal/total budget and HAT fuse/harness rating; do not consume the existing 0.1 A reserve silently.

options.label: UWB · optional
options.description: Optional Qorvo DWM3000 for two-way UWB ranging and cooperative-localization anchor service.
interfaces: Dedicated 3.3 V SPI chip select / bus allocation
IRQ, reset and wake controls; exact GPIO assignments pending
options.antenna: Integrated antenna. Keep its radiating end toward plastic with manufacturer copper/metal clearance; Pi, busbars, Ethernet shields and DC wiring must remain outside the final RF exclusion region.

options.label: GNSS · optional
options.description: Optional u-blox MAX-M10S provides satellite position and a time reference for the ground station, with sky visibility.
interfaces: UART to Pi; I2C is an alternative, exact pin allocation pending
TIMEPULSE to a hardware-capture input; backup supply policy pending
options.antenna: Requires a separate GNSS antenna and RF network; reserve a lid-facing patch or an optional external-antenna connection. Antenna part, ground plane, bias/protection and packaging remain to be designed; no external hole is implied by this display.

localization_requirements: Baseline two-way ranging; establish/calibrate anchor coordinates and antenna delays.
GNSS position is standard precision; no RTK or surveyed-anchor precision claim.
PPS alone is not a qualified network-wide UWB timebase. TDoA requires a separate clock synchronization and timestamp error budget.
Implement ground-station service and distribute range/position/time observations over existing Ethernet.
pricing: Selected MAX launch price is $599, $30 above the prior $569 estimate to provide optional-sensor headroom. The base cost model excludes both optional fitments and antenna/support circuitry; final option costs/pricing remain pending the detailed BOM.
remaining_gates: Pin-complete optional circuits and BOM/DNP variants; host bus/GPIO allocation
Antenna selection, RF keepouts, enclosure tuning, coexistence and certification
Supply transient/thermal budget, revised branch protection and current ratings
Physical fit, wiring/service access, ranging calibration and software validation
